verified_facts.text: evolve_metric_expr selects the round-best metric from the combined dev-agreement and train-coverage score before calling _report_locked; eval_locked is report-only and has no write path into metric selection, gating, rollback, synthesis, or elite ranking.

run_coevolution calls _prepare once before alternating phases; _prepare constructs the soft eval_dev anchor, eval_locked outputs, and train outputs once from frozen no-skill solver outputs, and every later metric phase reuses those same dev_items, locked, and train objects.

Skill phases are graded by the current evolved metric through make_expr_grader, while the skill-phase outputs are not inserted into the dev_items or train objects consumed by later metric phases; the released coupling is metric-to-skill without a reciprocal skill-output-to-metric-data path.
